name: Hertzian contact
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 依据Hertz弹性接触理论描述的接触关系。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道动力模型中，用于描述轮轨法向弹性压缩与接触力之间的关系，依据法向压缩量计算法向接触力，也可作为不同接触建模方法的对照。

complete_examples.text: In multibody dynamics based on force-equilibrium methods, Hertzian contact and creep theories have been applied in vehicle–track model constructions.
The second one is to investigate the dynamic influence of rail irregularities and the difference of results derived by this model and Hertzian contact theory in the 3-D space.
Unlike the wheel-rail rigid contact of the present model, Hertzian contact is applied in [20] to consider the wheel-rail normal elastic contact.
